# INDEPENDENT ELECTRIC BIKES

> Australia's Premier Independent Electric Commuter & Cargo Bike Specialist. Operated by VYRON Industries Pty Ltd (ABN 23 618 699 479) in Brunswick, Victoria since 2017.

## Overview
INDEPENDENT ELECTRIC BIKES provides high-torque commuter electric bikes, dual-battery cargo e-bikes, compact folding bikes, and fat tire cruisers tailored for Australian urban traffic and trail conditions.

- **Entity:** VYRON INDUSTRIES PTY LTD (ABN 23 618 699 479)
- **Headquarters:** 380 Sydney Road, Brunswick VIC 3056, Victoria, Australia
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +61 480 811 308 (WhatsApp: 61480811308)
- **Email:** sales@independentelectricbikes.com.au
- **Minimum Order:** $300 AUD
- **Free Express Freight:** Orders over $1,500 AUD across Victoria and metro Australia
- **Discounts:** 10% discount on Cryptocurrency payments (BTC / USDT) and direct Bank Transfer/PayID options

## Product Categories
- [Electric Commuter Bikes](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/commuter/): Sleek 350W-500W urban commuters featuring Samsung batteries and hydraulic brakes.
- [Cargo Electric Bikes](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/cargo/): Heavy-duty dual-battery long-tail utility e-bikes with 150kg payload capacity.
- [Folding Electric Bikes](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/folding/): Compact 10-second folding e-bikes for train commutes and RV trips.
- [Fat Tire & Cruisers](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/cruiser/): All-terrain 26x4.0 fat tire step-through cruisers for beach and rail trails.

## E-Bike Lineup
- [Lekker Jordaan Urban 8sp](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/electric-bikes/lekker-jordaan-urban-8sp/): $3,098 AUD — Dutch-style urban commuter, Shimano 8sp internal hub, Bafang motor.
- [Aventon Level 3 Step-Through](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/electric-bikes/aventon-level-3-step-through/): $2,899 AUD — Torque sensor pedal assist, front suspension fork, turn signals.
- [Tern GSD S10 LX](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/electric-bikes/tern-gsd-s10-lx/): $7,995 AUD — 200kg gross payload, Bosch Cargo Line 85Nm motor, Magura hydraulic brakes.
- [DiroDi Rover Plus Gen 6 Step-Thru](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/electric-bikes/dirodi-rover-plus-gen-6-step-thru/): $2,999 AUD — Retro fat tyre step-thru, 750W peak motor, Samsung 15Ah battery.
- [Specialized Turbo Como 3.0](https://independentelectricbikes.com.au/shop/electric-bikes/specialized-turbo-como-30/): $4,299 AUD — Specialized mid-drive 2.0E motor, 530Wh battery, hydraulic brakes.
